title: Hangar chat
subtitle: Zigzag pulls Elon onto the pad.
disclaimer: Stylized planetarium dialogue — not an official SpaceX interview.

beats.text: Elon. I flew in from the Magellanic Cloud. Your metal tubes keep punching the sky. Walk me through the family.
Start with Falcon 1. Five flights from Kwajalein. That was the proof we could reach orbit without a government rocket.
Five flights. Then you stacked nine Merlins. Reckless. Beautiful. I like the cadence.
Falcon 9 is the workhorse. Landing the booster was the plot twist. Reuse is how you get the launch table sitting under this pad.
And the three-core stack? Looks like you glued two extra tubes on for luck.
Falcon Heavy. Twenty-seven engines at liftoff. When the payload is heavy and the destination is far, you bring friends.
Starship is the one that smells like a city. Stainless. Huge. Still in flight test.
Starship is the city bus to Mars. Super Heavy plus Ship. That is the vehicle that makes a multiplanet species possible.
I will keep the pad running. Tap a rocket if you want the next lift-off. I will be in the hangar.
